instruction: Candid documentary wide shot from a low angle of an indoor motion capture studio featuring a red carpet and white walls. From behind, the bearded man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, facing away from the camera. Beside him, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing away. The man reaches his right hand back to touch the woman's upper back. The scene is illuminated by even overhead fluorescent lighting, creating a neutral color palette dominated by the red floor.
